static_traits.name: 张泰乐
static_traits.social_status: 社会支持系统较弱，难以与他人讨论自我not足感；因Self-doubt而回避摄影相关社交活动
static_traits.medical_history: 既往without类似心理问题与治疗经历；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性好、配合度高；能自我Reflection，情绪略显Anxiety并对自我评价较为苛刻

basic_info.main_problem: 因为有些照片have not达到Anticipation效果，我一直觉得自己是个糟糕的Photographer；几个月前收到负面反馈后，每次拍照都会怀疑自己的能力。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些not足感一直妨碍我的创作过程和对摄影的热情，影响到我的整体幸福感，因此希望通过咨询缓解Self-doubt、重建信心。
growth_experiences: 几个月前在作品上收到负面反馈后开始出现Persistent self-doubt：在回看照片或接受他人反馈时都会联想到“I am not good enough”，并且逐渐将少量not理想的作品等同于整体能力not足，导致Decline in creative motivation、项目拖延与回避拍摄。

Had received praise for works in exhibitions many times, and a photography project completed last year obtained much positive feedback; these experiences once brought a sense of achievement and the experience of being seen, but recent negative feedback makes these positive memories seem distant.
19岁时处于Widowed状态、Living alone（具体细节Not mentioned），社会支持系统较弱，情感支持资源not足。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/我是个糟糕的Photographer
My worth depends on others' evaluations of my work

special_situations.event: Receiving negative feedback on one's work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果作品被批评，就证明我能力not足、not会成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces shooting, avoids occasions where they might be evaluated, or tries to improve quickly by taking online courses to avoid failing again

special_situations.event: 回看照片时发现部分作品not yet达Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果有些照片达not到完美标准，就等于我整体水平很差
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinates on or avoids starting new projects, repeatedly checks and picks at her own work
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些照片not好，说明我have not天赋。

special_situations.event: Thinking of or facing photography-related social/exhibition settings where one may be evaluated by others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能让do not人满意，就说明我not值得被认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids photography social events, reduces interaction with peers to avoid being compared and judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我水平很差，会看not起我。

special_situations.event: Recalls praise once received at exhibitions or projects
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面反馈not可靠或not具代表性，只有负面才真实
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate和贬低正面评价，持续提高标准以维持“警惕”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些称赞not算数，只是运气好。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可、被看见其作为Photographer的价值与能力
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate与羞辱，担心失败意味着自我价值被彻底推翻
defense_goal: 通过回避被评价的场合以降低被negate的风险
Gains a sense of control through self-criticism and excessive self-demands

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、羞愧的学习者/失败者
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻、挑剔的评判者/观众

object_relations.self_representation: 需要取悦他人的表演者
object_relations.object_representation: Others/groups who must be pleased and satisfied

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor guides one to recall positive feedback and successful experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为那些成功not具代表性、not能说明整体能力
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和但negate的语气淡化积极证据，例如“那只是运气好”，并给出看似客观的理由弱化成功。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing others' feedback or potential evaluation scenarios
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内在的自我批评体验外归，预设他人会全面negate自己
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use推测性语言强调他人的负面看法（如“They will think I am terrible”），并据此表达Withdrawal意愿。

manifestations: Widowed且Living alone，缺乏强有力的社会支持系统
Avoids photography-related social activities, reducing contact with peers
Self-doubt侵蚀创作热情，将自我价值过度系于外部评价
对摄影的兴趣与投入减少

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 在评片时频繁Self-denial（“I am not good enough”“I will never succeed”）
担心被评价而谨慎Withdrawal，Reduced socializing与曝光

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 预设他人会看not起自己的作品，在社交场景中倾向假设负面评价
基于对他人想法的猜测而Avoids communication

exception_events.target_problem: 在回看作品或面临他人评价时，张泰乐通常会将少量not理想的照片等同于整体能力not足，从而Self-doubt、回避继续创作，导致项目拖延。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 去年完成的一个摄影项目获得大量赞誉，他在创作过程中体验到成就与被看见，与平时的Self-doubt相比显著减轻。
exception_events.reason: not同支持：来自观众/同行的正向反馈；not同理解与情境：该项目契合其擅长的“情感与故事”主题，投入度高、专注于表达而非取悦他人。

exception_events.target_problem: 在摄影社交场合中，张泰乐往往担心被评价而选择Withdrawal，进而减少曝光与互动机会。
exception_events.unique_outcome: At multiple exhibitions, his works received praise from the audience and peers; at that time he could feel gratified and confident, rather than belittling himself across the board.
exception_events.reason: not同情境：展览氛围更包容、非评审式；not同支持：现场积极回馈降低了被negate的Anticipation。

positive_force: Passion and strengths in photography for capturing emotion and stories
Past successful experiences (exhibition praise, good reviews on annual projects) provide evidence of real ability
主动寻求帮助与学习（网络课程、愿意进行咨询），具备Reflection能力
Able to accept feedback and restructure cognitions under structured methods
negative_force: 过度概括、negate正向、读心术等认知偏差维持Self-doubt
Over-relies on external evaluation (External Validation) to define self-worth
The behavioral pattern of avoiding filming and socializing reduces positive feedback and growth opportunities
社会支持系统薄弱与Loneliness感加剧负性情绪与Decreased drive
Black-and-white thinking and high standards cause constant pressure

target_behavior.behavior: 回避拍摄新作品与项目拖延
antecedent: 回看照片发现部分not理想
When preparing to take on a client shoot, associates it with possible failure
target_behavior.core_reason: 将少量not理想表现灾难化并过度概括为能力not足，害怕失败与被negate
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的羞耻与负面评价，暂时缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: The project is delayed, the creative process is obstructed, and confidence drops further

target_behavior.behavior: 回避摄影相关社交活动
antecedent: Needs to attend exhibitions, peer gatherings, or work-sharing sessions
预想到会被比较与评价
target_behavior.core_reason: 读心术与外部验证倾向，预设他人会negate自己
target_behavior.function: 逃避Social anxiety与被评判的not适
target_behavior.consequence: 社会支持与正向反馈减少，Loneliness与Intensifying self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-statements of repeated self-deprecation during photo review
target_behavior.core_reason: 内在信念“I am not good enough”，伴随心理过滤与negate正向的认知偏差
target_behavior.function: Maintains a negative schema about her own abilities, gaining a surface sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood、Decreased motivation，进一步Reinforcement回避与拖延
